name: Bristol Plaza
summary: Bristol Plaza is a community shopping center on Farmington Avenue in Bristol, Connecticut, managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust. The center serves local residents with convenient access to everyday retailers and services, maintaining strong customer satisfaction with a 4.2-star rating.
demographics: Bristol Plaza serves a diverse middle-income demographic in the Bristol, Connecticut area, attracting families and working professionals from the surrounding Hartford County suburbs. The trade area consists primarily of households with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees. Shoppers are drawn to the center's convenient location on Farmington Avenue and its practical mix of everyday retailers and services. The customer base values accessibility, ample parking, and a straightforward shopping experience focused on daily needs and routine purchases.
description: Bristol Plaza is a well-established community shopping center located at 641 Farmington Avenue in Bristol, Connecticut, serving the greater Hartford County area. Owned and managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a nationally recognized real estate investment trust with a diverse portfolio of high-quality retail properties across the United States, Bristol Plaza benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in the property. The center provides convenient access to a variety of retailers and services that cater to the everyday needs of local residents and families. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Bristol Plaza offers flexibility for shoppers throughout the day and evening. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.2-star rating from over 1,500 customer reviews, demonstrating consistent satisfaction with the shopping experience and tenant mix.
